segment_title: YOUR PACKAGE CAME LATE — THAT IS A REFUND YOU NEVER CLAIMED
script_text: WHEN YOU CHECK OUT, SOMETIMES AMAZON SHOWS YOU A GUARANTEED DELIVERY DATE. NOT AN ESTIMATE. A GUARANTEE. AND THEY PUT IT IN WRITING IN YOUR CONFIRMATION EMAIL. AMAZON'S OWN TERMS SAY IF THEY MISS THAT DATE, YOUR SHIPPING FEES MAY BE REFUNDED. SO GO FIND THAT EMAIL. THAT EMAIL IS YOUR RECEIPT. HERE'S THE EXACT PATH AMAZON PUBLISHES. GO TO YOUR ORDERS... SELECT THE LATE ORDER... CLICK PROBLEM WITH AN ORDER... THEN SHIPPING OR DELIVERY ISSUES... THEN SHIPMENT IS LATE. NOW IF YOU'RE A PRIME MEMBER WHO NEVER PAID A SHIPPING FEE, THERE'S NOTHING TO REFUND... SO ASK THE AGENT FLAT OUT FOR AN ACCOUNT CREDIT INSTEAD. YOU HAVE TO SAY THE WORDS. WATCH HIM SHOW YOU HOW.
